newsitem.title: USA: Analyst sees strong quarter for REITs - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Analyst sees strong quarter for REITs - Barron's.

text.p: Robert Frank, the director of research at Legg Mason, told Barron's business weekly he expected real estate investment trusts to pick up momentum this quarter and beyond.

He said the REIT fundamentals were strong, with a big yield advantage over most stocks. He said this quarter was likely to be a big one because there were four REIT initial public offerings in registration to raise about $1 billion, Barron's said.
Some of his favorites include FelCor Suite Hotels Inc, Patriot American Hospitality Inc, CarrAmerica Realty Corp, Beacon Properties Corp and Reckson Associates Realty Corp.
